Method of Attack: Loaded from legitimate infrastructure previously compromised by the threat actor
DLL search-order hijacking to execute next-stage payloads or deploy remote access trojans (RATs)
Creation of a new user account ('krtbgt') to impersonate Kerberos Ticket Granting Ticket
Addition of the 'krtbgt' account to the Local Administrators Group
Deployment of a custom proxy tool ('HazyLoad') to establish persistent connections
Termination of the TeamCity service via RDP to prevent access by other threat actors
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2023-42793 vulnerability in JetBrains TeamCity
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious DLLs such as DSROLE.dll, RollSling, Version.dll, and FeedLoad
